reviewer: independent development subagent industrial_sources, not external human/institution
scope: Read-only production OOC integration review; contract/resource/candidate-acceptance paths; no large matrix or container launched by reviewer

findings.before: OOC legal low-memory config raised uncaught RuntimeError RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED; API generic handler returned 500 INTERNAL_ERROR rather than resource rejection. Independently reproduced with n20 temporary service and memory_limit_gib=0.1.
findings.resolution: Root added narrow RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED prefix mapping to ServiceError RESOURCE_ESTIMATE_EXCEEDED; unexpected RuntimeError still propagates.

findings.before: An already-completed child skipped all while-loop private disk/log checks. Independently reproduced private directory 2558 bytes versus 1073.7 byte configured budget returning candidates.
findings.resolution: Owner added private_directory_bytes with early stop and deleted-file tolerance, unified private disk/log checks before launch, while running, and after exit before result parsing.

findings.before: Parent run-directory scan calls is_file then stat without deleted-file tolerance; MUMPS factor/workspace teardown can remove an entry in between. Independently reproduced FileNotFoundError escaping monitor with a disappearing-entry fixture and no solver work.
findings.recommended_resolution: Reuse private_directory_bytes(directory, disk_limit) or an equivalent deletion-tolerant non-symlink directory counter, with a parent-monitor regression.
findings.resolution: Parent monitor now reuses deletion-tolerant private_directory_bytes with configured limit; independent focused regression reaches ordinary WORKER_LOST finalization instead of escaping FileNotFoundError.

accepted_design_checks.explicit_profile: mumps_ooc_symmetric_v1 has its own real single-rank runtime self-test; capability seed binds image id, driver hash, local Docker endpoint and known profile. Legacy LU combinations remain separate.
accepted_design_checks.restriction: Rejects GPU, complex input, multiple MPI ranks, multiple threads, adaptive linear precision, unsupported target/transform/checkpoint combinations. Matrix dtype is checked again at actual input load.
accepted_design_checks.mumps_factorization: Real symmetric indefinite path explicitly sets SPD false and requests PETSc PCCHOLESKY/MUMPS; API name alone does not claim positive definiteness. Work area ICNTL(22/23) is verified after solve.
accepted_design_checks.memory: One configured job memory budget split between host worker tree and container. Docker memory-swap equals memory share. MUMPS workspace 64–768 MiB is only part of container RSS; estimate does not call it total-memory bound.
accepted_design_checks.disk: Factors are task-private output data subject to monitored budget and cleanup, not automatically public artifacts. This is sampled enforcement, not an operating-system disk quota or guarantee of exact transient peak.
accepted_design_checks.isolation: Candidate container network none, read-only root, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges, user identity, bounded pids/cpus/tmpfs, only input snapshot and private outputs mounted; watchdog limits orphan lifetime.
accepted_design_checks.cleanup: Finally kills live docker client and removes named owned container/workspace. If removal cannot complete, marker retained for controlled recovery.
accepted_design_checks.failure: Known OOC failure reasons and bounded diagnostic fields preserved; no arbitrary native error text promoted into result.
accepted_design_checks.candidate_acceptance: SLEPc output remains candidates only; adapter validates residuals and maps row order, core independently recomputes original-matrix residuals and certification. Convergence reason/INFOG inertia do not produce CERTIFIED.
accepted_design_checks.industrial_claim: Passing this code review or small self-test does not establish GSM modes, complete target coverage, physical frequency or official contest acceptance.
